MESSAGE: Prefer adding a supported reaction, replying with a supplied purpose, or editing/deleting an actor-owned message. Read fallback can extract distinct facts from the selected message text.
USER: Prefer opening a DM and messaging the selected user with a supplied purpose. Profile updates are unavailable. A read can report exposed profile facts, not invented job titles.
CONVERSATION: Prefer archiving, renaming, setting the topic, or posting a supplied message in the selected conversation. Its topic/name/type and membership can be read.
CONVERSATION_MEMBERSHIP: Prefer removing the selected member from the conversation belonging to that membership. User and conversation are both part of the selected membership; do not invent equality with another channel appearing along the route. Membership join times and per-channel admin roles are unavailable.
REACTION: Prefer removing the actor's own selected reaction: choose actor-owned reactions when constructing the story. Other people's reactions cannot be removed. A read can report the reactor or emoji, but the answer should distinguish competing reactions.
WORKSPACE: No supported write. Read the workspace identifier exposed by discoverable users' profiles or channel associations. Workspace names and general workspace enumeration are unavailable. Establish the route through discoverable associations rather than assuming access to every workspace.
WORKSPACE_MEMBERSHIP: No supported write. Read the administrator/owner flags or workspace identifier on the selected discoverable user's profile association. Ordinary-member versus guest classification is unavailable; ask about the specific exposed flag, not a full role label. Restrict the population to those displayed profile associations.
